acceptance: Measure installed NtReadVirtualMemory on controlled own-process buffers, including zero length, rights/type validation, return-count probes, guard/noaccess regions, partial copy and aliases before implementation.
Implement the verified current virtual-process behavior through shared guest memory only; no host process reads from guest-selected inputs, and foreign-process frontiers remain explicit.
Wire the NTDLL entry for all four Windows guest ABIs; preserve exact native status/store/guard behavior and pointer widths.
Replay original native observations on Windows/macOS/Linux and prove actual owning Rust/C++ callers, installed smoke/whoami progress, source frames and linear exact red publication.

assumptions.assumption: The recorded current-process read can use the guest virtual address space and existing process-handle grants.
assumptions.basis: Owning whoami frontier is NtReadVirtualMemory with handle -1 and an eight-byte read of guest PEB image-base storage.
assumptions.stress-test: Pseudo process/thread, valid owned process handles, insufficient grants, foreign process and wrong types.
assumptions.falsification-probe: Native handle/access ordering or source address ownership differs from this model.
